$comment: Mapping of the six initial products to the reference store's photographs. Audited 2026-10-15: each reference product page exposes exactly one photo (front view on mannequin, 1200x1200 WebP). No back, detail or alternate views exist on the reference site. Files are only fetched once 'authorization.authorized' is true. Swatch colours for vert, jaune and bleu were sampled from the photos so the colour dots match the jackets.
